enforce.mechanism: the planner selects the collection variant from the composition

constraints.test: constraint.test.mjs — stated composition selects the matching variant
constraints.failureMessage: composition "index" was declared but the planner produced a different surface
constraints.statement: The collection must use the "index" composition.

constraints.evidence: imagery.role: "None." (stated in the spec, compiled to a prohibition)

enforce.mechanism: the card variant is not selected; the renderer is checked

constraints.failureMessage: media appears although imagery.role is None
constraints.statement: The spec declares no imagery role, so no media block may be rendered.

constraints.evidence: inferred from the responsive requirement: a table wider than the viewport must be discoverable

enforce.mechanism: the renderer emits the affordance; the critique checks it is discoverable

constraints.test: responsive.test.mjs — affordance present, keyboard-reachable, no lost columns
constraints.failureMessage: a table overflows the viewport with no discoverable affordance
constraints.statement: At mobile widths a table that overflows must expose a discoverable scroll affordance and stay keyboard-reachable.

enforce.mechanism: index variant emits no card class

constraints.failureMessage: cards appear in an index composition
constraints.statement: An index composition implies no card chrome.

conflicts.statement: composition "index" cannot render 1 numeric field(s) (qty) that the brief declares as content.
conflicts.resolution: The requirement and the composition conflict. The build must stop and ask for a decision rather than dropping the numbers.
